capacity_receipt.limitation: Short protocol/ingress test has no warmup credit; update speed measured separately on static data. Not training performance or maximum cluster capacity.

reward.zero_sample_rule: retain boundary srtt; measured5621/92282 empty intervals,2 with positive bytes

ending_map.reset: truncated with same-connection real successor only; otherwise censored

calibration.c: physical-exposure weighted interval utility; freeze once

connection_schedule.connection1: 20/40/80/120ms blocks each >=40 physical seconds, then120ms padding until180s reset
connection_schedule.connection2: 160ms block >=40 physical seconds, then close; calibration connection never becomes training connection
connection_schedule.padding: Measured separately; not used for c/n0/b labels, no replay/credit; all actual exposure debited from1800s/actor

calibration.weighting: c: physical exposure; fitted b: equal valid decision weights in fit blocks; numerator/denominator same weights
calibration.bias_rechecks: one fit correction only; independent check reported; not an A stopping gate

optimization.order: Q1+Q2 -> N -> optional actor -> BN -> uniquely name-paired targets
optimization.BN_update_rule: Update online BN after actor only; full actor including BN frozen during initial5000 critic-only iterations; target BN uses moving stats and follows once per target update

planned_training.run_boundary: NOT_SCHEDULED: this task covers A0 only; next-stage cluster integration and capacity must pass
planned_training.launch_cutoff: Do not start unless enough reserve remains for all264 planned60s runs at verified concurrency and measured startup overhead
planned_training.checkpoint: each300s mean actual per-actor total exposure incl calibration; credit only real training replay

early_stop.queue_reference: Same-condition/same-period old V31 trim10 mean queue from completed A0 supplement-v2; full120 rows and source hashes in grid metrics; not a causal comparator

calibration_thresholds.unit: new reward-v1 centered discounted utility; no threshold relaxation after results
calibration_thresholds.correction: at most once on fit set, never on check set

B0.selection: first repetition develop; independent confirmation; insufficient independent runs => PARTIAL

repeat_requirement.unit: independent complete TCP connection, paired by condition/host/repeat
repeat_requirement.paired_CI: stratified by condition, resample independent matched connection pairs; conditions are not IID packet samples; family adjusted inference or PARTIAL
repeat_requirement.power_status: Bounded screening only:33/120 historical condition/model pairs illustrate need for more than4; not a stability guarantee. No automatic hundreds-of-repeat expansion; if precision fails reportPARTIAL.

B0.frontier: randomization between whole independent connections; uniform weights across conditions; never linearly mix pooled packet quantiles
B0.optimizer: own deterministic target per critic, no min/smoothing; N and target once/update; actor/BN frozen

randomized_check.strata: condition x first/second half; choose nextT uniformly, hold>=20s; separate check connections

B0.reference: same A window family: period with highest12-condition mean utilization in development repetition1; freeze before confirmation
B0.lambda_choice: Development repeat1: meet all registered network bounds then minimum measured total owned CPU, tie=>smaller lambda; no feasible lambda=>FAIL; confirmation cannot reselect
B0.noninferiority: Do not widen tolerances because noise is large; insufficient CI precision=>PARTIAL

historical_noise_audit.decision: Register4 independent confirmations as a bounded screening floor, not a powered stability guarantee. If confidence precision fails, B0 is PARTIAL; no tolerance widening or result-driven extra runs.
historical_noise_audit.limitation: Old reward/model families, only2 repeats/pair; t3 planning multiplier is an illustration, not a power guarantee for a new algorithm or pooled quantiles.

rule.mode: existing hysteresis pressure rule with discrete candidate adapter
rule.pressure: last7 features: loss>0.01 or minRTT/sRTT<0.8 or throughput/observed_peak<0.9
rule.snap: nearest candidate by log-distance; tie shorter; resets per connection
rule.source: common_period.Hysteresis; fixed before any A/B0 result
rule.window: same mu(s,T), no alternate window policy

CPU.mode: deployment no per-step logs, batch five candidates
CPU.denominator: user+system seconds/wall seconds; one core=100%; separate host all-core average
CPU.measurement: user+system deltas over persistent exact-owned PID inventory including reparented Mahimahi; Python/native/total separately; host busy separately
